body:
Founder: 'can we add a weapon 7 ... a flashlight - use a cone with a shader - at night in shankpit it gets dark.' WPN_FLASHLIGHT=7, pure utility slot (no ammo/damage), key 7 to equip, on while equipped/off when switched away. Real GLSL vertex+fragment shader cone (gl_shader.c/DynamicVBO foundation, reuses the normal-attribute slot for radial/axial falloff), additively blended. flashlight_box_boost wired into draw_map's existing per-box lighting pass for real local brightening within the cone. Built clean, live-verified shader compile+link and weapon-hold+boost-math under Xvfb; full in-match pixel screenshot blocked by a test-harness-only scene_id sync quirk, named honestly in the commit rather than overclaimed. Commit bd3f74b.

⚓ ☃
title: Ship weapon 7: flashlight (shader cone + world brightening)
